name: Boris Ursus
canonNotes: Tzar Boris, an implacable warlord and cultural reformer, one of Kislev's greatest rulers, who rides the great bear Mortkin.
His revival of the Cult of Ursun makes him popular with the pious, and his militarism gives him sway over the soldiery.
voiceNotes: Hearty, blunt and heroic; talks of bears, the steppe and old glories.
Generous to brave friends, fierce to foes.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
